svg.text: The condition-free model: train on Qwen’s instructed views, read the default image once
The instructed views build the training signal only (buddy graphs and teacher targets). At test time one default image gives emotion, style and genre spaces.
Training: on the training paintings only, no labels; the same recipe for each aspect (emotion, style, genre)
1 Four views of each painting from one frozen embedder
one prompt per aspect makes the instructed views
“Describe the style of this artwork in one word”
“Describe the genre of this artwork in one word”
why instructed views: an instruction makes Qwen cluster the paintings by one aspect
(own-aspect AMI up, the other aspects down); the network learns that geometry from the
default view, so it needs no instruction at test time
default view, no instruction: the network’s input
instructed views: the training signal only
the instructed image embedding of the aspect is the teacher target
2 The network: two sides; each a shared trunk and three aspect heads (trained)
each head 1024 → 2048; the two sides share no weights
caption outputs: to the buddy loss only
3 The training signal, from the instructed views
buddy graph in the instructed view
paintings (emotion on captions, style and genre on
images); emotion and style first subtract the
the paintings close to it in that aspect
the aspect’s image and caption heads:
a painting’s outputs are pulled toward
its buddies’ outputs on that aspect’s
graph; the other paintings in the
its output is pulled toward the
4 The losses, one pair per aspect
Test time: one pass of the default image; no instruction, no caption
scored by AMI against the paintings’
labels enter only here, never training
a student on SigLIP or CLIP changes only the image input layer of the trunk; graphs, teacher and captions stay Qwen’s at training
